notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
After gathering feedback, here's a small update with some fixes.

[list]
[*] The stairs graphic in Temple B2 was showing the wrong direction.
[*] Fix a typo on the end screen, retreived -> retrieved.
[*] The number of shadow enemies should not all be 20.
[*] Resetting the bonus level should set the life properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Magirune 2 is out!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I want to start with a big thank you for all your good feedback since the beginning! After a bit more than a year of hard work, Magirune 2 is finally out.

I suggest you try out the demo first to see if you like the gameplay. If you do, I'm convinced you will like the rest of the game :)

Happy playing!

notes.title: New update V0.10
notes.notes:
New update!

[list]
[*] Red slime is not properly called "Red Slime".
[*] Removed an extra Red Slime.
[*] Don't display weapon message when the demo girl is visible.
[*] The player will shake when getting hit.
[*] First level of temple designed.
[*] No more hidden enemies.
[*] Added the game logo on the splash screen.
[*] Changed some text.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo and new updates
notes.notes: Thanks for all the people that wish list the game! Still working on the full game and it's going well. In the mean time, a demo was posted. Should give you all a nice overview on how the game plays. Listening to all feedback.
